definition: Stephen Malvern Omohundro (born 1959) is an American computer scientist whose areas of research include Hamiltonian physics, dynamical systems, programming languages, machine learning, machine vision, and the social implications of artificial intelligence.
details: His current work uses rational economics to develop safe and beneficial intelligent technologies for better collaborative modeling, understanding, innovation, and decision making.

explainer.lead: Steve Omohundro is an American computer scientist. His work spans artificial intelligence.

contributions.name: Subutai Ahmad and Steve Omohundro developed biologically realistic neural models of selective attention.

As a research scientist at the NEC Research Institute, Omohundro worked on machine learning and computer vision, and was a co-inventor of U.S. Patent 5,696,964, "Multimedia Database Retrieval System Which Maintains a Posterior Probability Distribution that Each Item in the Database is a Target of a Search."

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, University of California, Berkeley
